Synthetic research edition

Open the assessment.

Inspect how supplied evidence becomes a bounded index, a review band and a separate screening route. These are selected examples spread across the generated score range.

Ask the software to prove it.

Each case has an explicit expected behavior, an executable assertion and retained observed evidence. Cases test arithmetic, boundaries, missing inputs, counterexamples and replay behavior; they do not estimate detection effectiveness.

Patterns are questions.

Compound hypotheses identify combinations worth examining. Every hypothesis includes a lawful alternative, the next evidence needed and a limit on its conclusion. Pattern matches add no hidden score points.

Know the denominator.

Feature definitions make units, observation windows and interpretation explicit. The value column shows the selected synthetic example. Unknown is distinct from an observed zero.
